text: If you must get rid of old clothes and shoes, you can resell them, or you can donate them. This guide shows you where to donate clothes and shoes in Berlin.
There are over 6000 donation bins for clothes in Berlin. They are often near supermarkets and gas stations. Map of clothes donation bins

title: Where will my clothes go?
text: Some belong to for-profit businesses. Some donation bins belong to charities. Donation bins with the FairWertung logo are run by charities. The Red Cross donation bins are also easy to recognise.

title: How to use the donation bins?
text: Donate clothes for the current season. Put your clothes in plastic bags to protect them Tie shoes together

Many clothes donation bins are operated by charities. Look for donation bins with the FairWertung logo. Those belong to charities. aktion-hoffnung Map of collection points Berliner Obdachlosenhilfe Lynarstraße 38, Wedding The clothes will be used to help the homeless in Berlin.
